source_law.text: Said driver having so yielded may proceed and the drivers of all other vehicles approaching the intersection on the through highway shall yield right-of-way to the vehicle about to enter or cross the through highway.

requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Both exact selected cases bind current-runtime primary/fallback offline, public positive/missing-road negative, recorded-only saved, canonical semantic, physical CPU fixture and independent delivery/comparison proofs. Original Native motion, highway designation, lawful first yield and legal outcome remain for local review.

Both selected requests include the same source-observed 140-frame prior stop before entrant approach. Selected antecedent and branch-allocation CPU audits reject missing stop and changed source. Whether this meets the preceding subsection's lawful yield remains an original-source legal review question; the fixture makes no legal claim.

requirement_dispositions.branch: entrant about to enter or cross
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Each selected 600-frame source sequence contains an about-to-enter approach followed by a contiguous intersection crossing, in the same fixed entrant history. The selected antecedent and branch-allocation CPU audits reject a missing crossing frame or absent approach phase. Original Native motion and legal timing remain for local review.
